summary: Enquiry about a fiber-based (in-line) measurement of water in a petroleum stream, to be located closer to the process with the analyzer outside the process area; the customer asks what to clarify and what a first comparison experiment should establish before equipment selection.

facts_stated.text: The material is a petroleum stream.
Water is currently determined by sending samples to a laboratory.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: currently send samples to a laboratory for water determination

facts_stated.text: They want to investigate a fiber-based measurement located closer to the process.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: a fiber based measurement closer to the process

facts_stated.text: The purpose is to notice changes sooner.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: so that changes can be noticed sooner

facts_stated.text: The analyzer would be located outside the process area.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The analyzer would be outside the process area

facts_stated.text: The customer asks what to clarify and what a first comparison experiment should establish before equipment selection.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Before selecting equipment, we need to know what to clarify and what a first comparison experiment should establish.

unknowns: Target species identity and concentration range (water content range and required detection limit)
Matrix composition and interferences (hydrocarbon type, additives, contaminants, other species absorbing in the same region)
Physical state of the stream at the measurement point (liquid, gas, multiphase) and whether free water or droplets can be present
Optical behaviour of the sample (clear, turbid, opaque, absorbing) and whether it varies with process conditions
Temperature and pressure at the proposed measurement point
Installation point, distance between probe and analyzer, and required fiber length / routing out of the process area
Fouling, deposition and cleaning requirements at the probe
Required accuracy, repeatability and response time
Which spectroscopic method and fiber family the fiber-based measurement would use
Reference method details (laboratory water determination procedure, uncertainty, sampling lag and representativeness)
Flow conditions (flow rate, slugging, phase separation) at the measurement point
Area classification and safety requirements for the probe inside the process area
